abstract: A case presentation of a newborn infant with intermittent, complete airway obstruction secondary to a pedunculated nasopharyngeal dermoid is presented. The differential diagnosis of obstructing nasopharyngeal lesions of the neonatal period is discussed, and an organized management strategy is proposed.
abstract_ja: 間欠的かつ完全な気道閉塞を呈した新生児の症例を提示します。原因は有茎性の鼻咽頭類皮嚢胞でした。新生児期に鼻咽頭病変が閉塞をきたす場合の鑑別診断を検討し、系統的な管理戦略を提案します。
